notes.title: CLOSED ALPHA MULTIPLAYER BUILD! – NEW RELEASE! – RAILROADS ONLINE!
notes.notes:
Dear community,

Big news! The Unreal multiplayer build has now reached the closed alpha version! For the last two months we have been testing the entire game under real multiplayer conditions in order to provide a smooth gameplay experience upon release!

A lot has happened during this last and very busy half year: We have added a lot of new rolling stock, various industries and freight types, realtime landscape editing features, and a stunning 16km^2 open world map. Also we have been growing as a team - alongside with our playerbase on Steam and our fanbase on the Discord server counting now 400+ members. 

We have built a completely new game in the Unreal engine with more content than ever. Because of the sheer size of the update and the countless hours spent working on it i also have decided to start a professional carrer in this industry as a game developer. 

As a result we have decided to release the Unreal version as a brandnew, separate game:  

                                                  RAILROADS ONLINE!

Besides all the mentioned features above RAILROADS Online! also comes translated into 10 different languages for all railroading fans around the world!
Therefore we will not overwrite „American Railroads“ - keeping it as the nice little Unity game for you to enjoy.

We are truely very grateful for your continuing support and would like to thank you for sticking with us for so long by offering you a special 10% discount in the first week upon release!

Everything regarding the release of RAILROADS ONLINE! will be posted in the following days right here as we are going to launch our first trailer very soon! There is still a lot of work ahead of us but we are confident that we will provide you the railroading experience you all are hoping for.

As always i will let the screenshots of the latest progress speak for itself.

Thank you!
Stefan

notes.title: Progress Update - 10/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Long time no see :) But we haven't been sleeping ;) I'd like to show you some of the latest progress on American Railroads!

A new locomotive has been implemented. It's a 2-8-0 Consolidation by Thomas, complete with tender and cab controls!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/50dd55e97d6ba4e8fdde7ff5330629577243aecc.jpg

Cab with interactive controls:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/61dbebedf36d0fe1777abfc29ebe98ad2527d010.jpg

The tender. We have put a lot of effort in a historically correct appearance on this one!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/9f468c4e571274b4aa73b3c0538ebc9df9ae4912.jpg

Headlight doors can be opened which allows you to light the burner
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/8eb2b33ba6c7a00ec251b904b8807e50038e4428.jpg

Sanding tower: refill your locomotive's sand domes here.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/48557000c154ee7114097f02da0ce6dfe8ea31fe.jpg

Water tower: The controls have been completely overhauled. You can now also swivel the spout left and right.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/7c85e67c6351b0745b7dc280693b836fe3d8dc7a.jpg

The mine, done by Kitsune, has been implemented. Pull the chutes and load your gondolas!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/646587694f582ef28ae5e917a1e23ebc5e22bf23.jpg

Iron ore.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/92a6b5fb547b6e3d26efb0d661c67ff0863e9e50.jpg

Trestles splines can now be dynamically placed just like different sets of track on the terrain.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/998e717b94f97cd01749519afa441bdad225de8a.jpg

Ideal to connect two hills:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/09135cb1e8c9a41f5bdd1db8b30100605a006a07.jpg

Also: A ton of coding, but that's not that interesting to show ;)

Next up: Saving and loading is going to be implemented. Also we have a bunch of new cars in stock, waiting to be added to the game ;)

We hope you enjoyed this small post!

If you haven't already joined, check out our official discord server down below for even more updates, screenshots and other cool stuff we will include!

Official Discord Server

See you soon ;)

notes.title: American Railroads - UPDATE 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

update 1.5 is finally here!
It is quite a jump from the last version so here are the major changes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/3e8ce749a3000a04300aadaf19f5c8556d54c345.jpg

First person controls:
Grab some firewood, throw it in the boiler and explore Pine Valley in the first person perspective! Move around freely, steer and control your vehicles manually with fully animated bars, regulators and gauges

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/a486691bafc958602a7c6cc25d411f55a1bf17da.png

Brand new cars, buildings, vehicles and tools: 
Update 1.5 adds not only many new vehicles but also more realism: vehicles require regular maintenance, water and fuel in order to stay operational

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/e7cf213e0600be36ceed99ec297402c24848fcde.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/396def9c73df5549c9fbb750f9500f46084b1f20.jpg

Build your own railroad:
Grab a pickaxe and start laying your own track! Invest in new equipment and place your utilities where they are needed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/210fcb4d7ab24a552ca42b40ff47e811e81f7dab.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/d295cadd8484e19e41d1a18ce0dba0ed8eb0021a.jpg

Customize your rolling stock: 
Buy new equipment and choose your individual options, numbers, company and vehicle names!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/16a49a866099106de500c74a8b4d08915534e285.jpg

New Roundhouse and facilities: 
Buy and upgrade a engine house to service your vehicles with increased repair speed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/a534b680141a27a1e7cc6e461a14fdb6adbf8f8d.png

Tutorial
The built in ingame tutorial pages will give you additional information

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/b675b8d604847e6d113958af268b180b14c51d1a.png

Improved graphics and physics simulation
New lighting, texture and post processing effects like vignetting and depth of field add a more natural look. Also the physics implementation has been fundamentally overworked to improve stability and framerate

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/ec9488dc6e9c307901bd17db2f99c04ce12cb7a5.jpg

Have fun!

notes.title: GIANT UPDATE 1.4
notes.notes:
Dear community - Update 1.4 is out now!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/906e3a76ca4a9f25f8145bd710c600909e753c16.png

This is a rather big one.
The following changes have been done:

-Added animated sawmill Pine Valley Lumber Co. with log pond
It is now possible to transport timber logs to the sawmill which then can be dumped into a log pond. The logs are then automatically processed and your company will recieve a payment

-Added logging camp Silver Creek. It is now possible to order logs at the logging camp in Silver Creek. The logs have to be loaded onto the cars and transported to the sawmill
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/90f2962ec7cf067156701d42533cd78680f78b24.png

-Added realistic lighting. The entire lighting of the map has recieved an overhaul. Shadows and fog along with new textures give the map a more realistic feeling
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/3b8712efeb1d4adf971e2a2aabe13d101b11c030.png

-Added new rail textures

-Added day/night cycle: The game has now a constant day and night cycle.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/077fe9ecea601e1864628ac7618ad7791e5a5ab8.png

-Added new watertower. The watertower has been retextured. The pipe recieved two animated steel wires
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/699761ab222ec1d9e48a93932e6729248b33d665.png

-Added company-screen. By pressing "F2" the company screen appears giving you information about your spendings and earnings

-Added interactive freight car iron bars: The iron bars of the freight cars can now be toggled by pressing F4/F6

-Added new log models and textures

-Added river segment

-Added new sound effects

-Adjusted crane controls: logs which are hooked onto the crane can now be turned by tapping "Q" or "E"

-Adjusted depth of field

-Adjusted help screen

-Adjusted switch controls: switches can now only be changed by directly looking over the switch lever and pressing "left mouse button"

-Fixed derailing issues by adjusting physX contact parameters. Derailments are still possible e.g when going too fast over a rail joint

-Improved loading: The loading time has been reduced

-Changed track layout of the stations

Starting a new game is recommended!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/cf0b1d6e39fcbd4b0b093afab7892d4f38737cf7.png


I hope you enjoy! And as always thanks for your support!

Best regards,
Stefan
